scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.1]: an interpolation site's leading NAME is [LNAM.2]'s identifier -- XID_Start then XID_Continue, either case -- so a non-ASCII binding (`ñame`) and a capitalised one (`Big`) are sites and render their values. PATH PINNED: `dsc.strlit`'s site reader, whose `name_start` / `name_continue` are `dsc.uniname`'s pinned tables, shared by `dsc.validate` (the site check and the reference walk) and `dsc.rete` (the lowering). Read with Mercury's own `char.is_alpha`, `{ñame...}` is not a site, and an `[a-z]` path rule refuses both.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    v: Int mutable

rule a:
    Ev ñame
->
    log info "a {ñame.v}"

rule b:
    Ev Big
->
    log info "b {Big.v}"
